lines: The new stage is on main in place of the measuring scene: a clear ball with simple refraction, the miniature as blocks, a base and lights per season, and the season change. The whole film now plays through all four seasons on it.
The particle engine is merged too and is being wired into the page in place of the test simulation. That is the last piece before the blockout round.
Next: the wiring, the machine checks, then the first blockout round and a publish with a globe you can shake.
phase 2: 3.08 h used of its 6.00 h box
allowance (before the review): 4.27 h used of 36.00 h allowed

pictures.caption: The whole film on the new stage, twelve frames from start to end: the pull back from inside the glass, four shakes with the season changing in each, a different camera between them, and the push back in that closes the loop. Every shape is a stand-in. (by Builder)

The first shake on the new stage from the locked hero camera, twelve frames across the bar: the lift, six strokes, the set down. The storm hides the miniature, the base and the lights turn from winter to spring behind it, and the globe lands on the bar line. Everything is a stand-in. (by Builder)
Sheet: 12 frames across the shot shake-1, frames 576 to 719, preview, draft

The new stage on main, winter at rest from the hero camera, draft samples. Everything in it is a stand-in: a clear ball with simple refraction, the miniature as blocks, a turned base in one colour, sprite lights behind. The snow in this picture still comes from the old test simulation. (by Builder)
